name: agemin-demo
description: React demo showing how to integrate Agemin age verification for age-gating content in a web app.

paragraphs: A React demonstration application showcasing how Agemin age verification can be seamlessly integrated into modern web applications. This demo uses a social media interface to illustrate real-world implementation patterns for age-gating content and protecting minors online.

This project demonstrates best practices for implementing Agemin's age verification SDK in a React application. The demo simulates a social media platform where age verification is required before accessing content, showcasing how developers can create compliant, user-friendly age-gating experiences.
The Agemin SDK provides a comprehensive solution for age verification, helping platforms comply with regulations while maintaining a smooth user experience.
features: 🔐 Seamless SDK Integration - Demonstrates proper implementation of the Agemin SDK
🎂 Age Gate Component - Reusable age verification component with customizable UI
🛡️ Content Protection - Shows how to restrict access to age-inappropriate content
📱 Mobile-Optimized - Responsive age verification flow for all devices
🔄 Session Management - Handles age verification state across user sessions
